decisions.what: MCP73831-2 (4.20 V) with RPROG 5.1 k -> ~196 mA
decisions.why: IREG = 1000 V / RPROG (PROG 10 k gives 90-110 mA in the EC table); 0.5C of the provisional 400 mAh cell
decisions.source: MCP73831/2 datasheet DS20001984, Electrical Characteristics (IREG at PROG = 10 k), parts/U2_MCP73831T-2ACI-OT_C424093.pdf

decisions.what: 4.7 uF ceramic at VDD and at VBAT
decisions.why: typical application circuit; stability with no battery

decisions.what: load sharing: Schottky VBUS->VSYS, P-MOSFET drain=VBAT source=VSYS gate=VBUS with 100 k to GND
decisions.why: with USB present the load runs off VBUS and the cell is isolated so the charger terminates on cell current only; without USB the PMOS connects the cell
decisions.source: OPINION (Microchip AN1149 'Designing A Li-Ion Battery Charger and Load Sharing System With Microchip's Stand-Alone Li-Ion Battery Charge Management Controller' - not fetched this run)

decisions.what: STAT drives a charge LED to 3V3? NO - to VBUS via LED+R
decisions.why: STAT is tri-state: low = charging, high-Z = shutdown/no battery, high = done; LED from VBUS (anode) to STAT lights only while charging and is dark on battery

decisions.what: no NTC (MCP73831 has no thermistor input)
decisions.why: P0 provisional: protected cell, thermal regulation of the charger die

layout_notes: charger near the USB connector (short VBUS), VBAT trace to JST-PH sized for 0.5 A
PMOS and Schottky between charger and LDO
thermal: 196 mA x (5.0-3.7 V) = 0.25 W worst in the charger at precondition end; thermal regulation folds back
errata: with no cell the charger output hunts around VREG: VBAT reads ~4.2 V with no battery - firmware must not treat it as a full cell
PMOS body diode conducts VBAT->VSYS if the gate is driven wrong - keep the gate pull-down
